safety_lead_time.comparison_action: reduce from SAP 2.8 days to 2.35 days

narrative: Demand for PL1__M6707BBC is erratic (CV=53.45%, gamma-like distribution) with moderate lead time variability (CV=50.39%), making the current SAP safety stock of 1,033 units insufficient for a 95% service level. The combined lead-time demand sigma of 6,253 units drives a recommended safety stock of 10,286 units. An (r,Q) continuous review policy with EOQ-aligned order quantity of 16,152 units reduces annual orders from ~368 to ~68, yielding net savings of $8,358.65/year (43%) while remaining well within the 69,325-unit storage cap.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic gamma-like demand with moderate lead time variability is best served by a continuous review trigger at a pre-computed reorder point, avoiding stockout exposure between periodic review intervals. The EOQ formula provides the cost-minimising order quantity above the MOQ constraint.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity utilisation is only 38.1% (26,438 / 69,325 units). No capacity constraint binds. Ample headroom exists for safety stock increases if service level target is raised.
